summary: The Republic of the Philippines filed a prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a registered offering of three tranches of global bonds: $550M 4.625% due 2031, $1.65B 5.325% due 2036, and $300M 5.750% due 2051 (a further issuance of existing 2051 bonds). The sovereign issuer is raising $2.5B in aggregate principal. Interest is semi-annual; bonds are direct, unconditional, unsecured general obligations ranking equally with other unsecured external debt. The 2051 tranche will be fungible with existing $750M issue. The offer is conditional on Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas approval; listing on Luxembourg Stock Exchange is sought. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
